card.text: GJ 1214 b was found in 2009 by MEarth Project as it crossed its star.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 1214 b"
sources.quote: GJ 1214 b is an exoplanet with a very high temperature that orbits the star GJ 1214, discovered in December 2009.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around GJ 1214. Its orbit and size follow Mahajan et al. 2024's fit, the archive's default.

sources.label: Wikipedia, "GJ 1214 b"
sources.quote: Its parent star is 48 light-years (15 pc) from the Sun, in the constellation Ophiuchus.
